full_prompt_en: A square hand drawn illustration places a tiny black stick figure near the lower center of a vast swirling red field. The figure stands on a thick near black ground band that rises from the lower left and curves beneath its feet. Its small white round head has two wide dark eyes and a short open mouth, and a thin dark body extends down into narrow legs. One short arm lifts away from the torso while the other stays close, giving the still figure a hesitant gesture. Behind it, intense scarlet and crimson marks spiral around a luminous pale red center slightly right of the upper middle. The strokes are not smooth gradients: thousands of short scratchy lines follow curved paths, making the red field feel as if it is turning inward. Near the top left and along the far left edge, dense black hatching presses into the red and darkens the corners. Smaller black flecks interrupt the bright center and scatter unevenly through the surrounding marks. The lower portion grows much darker as red strokes mix with heavy black scribbles, connecting the abstract background to the ground beneath the figure. The white head is the clearest light shape in the foreground, although the diffuse glow behind it occupies a much larger area. There is no visible horizon, object, or readable text beyond the small standing character and the swirling marks. The brightest glow seems to emanate from the center of the red spiral, fading into darker scratched edges rather than casting a natural shadow. The overall composition makes the fragile figure feel isolated inside a huge, agitated field of red and black.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形手绘插画把一个小小的黑色火柴人放在广阔旋转红色场域的下方中央附近。人物站在一条近黑色厚地带上，地带从左下方升起，并在脚下弯曲。小小的白色圆头上有两只睁大的深色眼睛和微张的短嘴，细长深色身体向下延伸成窄腿。一只短手臂从躯干旁抬起，另一只贴近身体，使静止的人物带着迟疑的动作。身后，强烈的猩红与深红笔痕围绕略偏右上中央的浅红发光中心盘旋。这些笔触不是平滑渐层；成千上万条短促、刮擦般的线沿弯曲路径排列，让红色区域仿佛向内旋转。左上方及最左边缘，密集黑色排线压入红色，使角落变暗。较小的黑点打断明亮中心，并不均匀地散落在周围笔痕中。下部随着红色线条与厚重黑色涂鸦混合而明显变暗，将抽象背景与人物脚下地带连在一起。白色头部是前景中最清楚的亮形，尽管后面的漫射光晕占据大得多的面积。除了小小的站立人物和旋转笔痕，画面没有可见地平线、物件或可读文字。最亮的光似乎从红色旋涡中心自行发出，向刮擦的暗边衰减，而不是投下自然阴影。整体构图让脆弱的人物在巨大的红黑躁动场域中显得孤立。
style_prompt_en: Hand drawn marks build an intense radial field from countless short, curved scratches and dense crosshatching. Saturated red is pushed through crimson into near black at the outer and lower edges, while a small pale core supplies the main luminous value. The texture remains visibly uneven, with stray flecks and broken lines interrupting the otherwise circular motion. A compact light accent can stand against the much larger dark zone, creating a sharp scale difference and immediate focus. Edges are rough and fibrous rather than airbrushed, and the darkest marks thicken where directional strokes gather. Light appears to emerge from within the color field, producing a graphic glow without a realistic source or modeled space. The composition is spare in its large-scale structure but restless at the level of individual marks. The overall effect is urgent, anxious, and visually hypnotic, with red energy compressed by surrounding black.
style_prompt_zh: 手绘痕迹以无数短促弯曲的刮线和密集交叉排线构成强烈的放射状场域。饱和红色经过深红，在外缘与下缘推向近黑色，中心一小块浅色提供主要的发光明度。肌理始终可见地不均匀，零散斑点和断裂线条打断原本环形的运动。一个紧凑的亮色重音可以立在大得多的暗区前，形成鲜明尺度差并立即聚焦。边缘粗糙而带纤维感，绝非喷枪般平滑；定向笔迹聚集之处，最深的痕迹会加厚。光仿佛从色场内部出现，形成图形化的光晕，而无须写实光源或塑形空间。构图的大尺度结构简洁，单个笔痕层面却躁动不安。整体效果紧迫、焦虑而有催眠般的视觉力，红色能量被外围黑色压缩。
theme_en: A tiny black stick figure before a swirling red void
theme_zh: 微小黑色火柴人在旋转的红色空茫中
name: Don Hertzfeldt
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
